verdict.rationale: cubic's own cross-repo reviews let users link related repositories so a review can check shared APIs, schemas, docs, or release work across projects. That is multi-project context, but it applies to PR reviews rather than a user-assembled session of multiple directories. missing for 10: documented ability to add multiple project directories to a single chat/CLI session, details on how linked-repo context is loaded or limited, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can include multiple project directories in a single session for broader context

citations.quote: Link related repositories so reviews can check shared APIs, schemas, docs, or release work.
Cross-repo reviews help cubic catch changes that need a matching update in another repository.
